fieldValues.title: The SRS elements behind the process
fieldValues.body: What the clerk reads and writes in srs-programme. When a stage changes, these are the records to check. Namespaces: `method` is `com.semanticops.method` (clerk `packages/method`), `programme` is `com.semanticops.programme`, `governance` is `com.mudemocracy.governance`, `stewardship` is `com.mudemocracy.stewardship`.
